description: A snapshot with a pending call, a history record and spawned children (`switchboard.road`). Switchboard r1 spawns lines 1 and 2, takes Caller r2's `lookup` at night into `pending`, and pauses, leaving `Working` from `Held`. Saved then, its snapshot has `calls` (the pending lookup), `history` (`Working.Last` recorded `Working.Held`) and `spawned` (both lines), and restoring it is refused (`calls`). Once `Answer` replies to the call, which r2 takes as its outcome, the snapshot saved again has no `calls`, and restoring it as r3 starts both lines again as r3.1 and r3.2; `Resume` there enters `Working.Held` through the history record.
